text: Four real requirements, all the way back from Lesson 84. Four real measures, each one answering exactly one of them directly and completely — genuinely no extras added along the way, and nothing speculative built just because it seemed interesting.
Regional performance, answered directly and completely: total sales measured against target, broken out by territory, exactly the way the VP originally asked for it.

Real profitability genuinely means margin as a percentage, not simply margin measured in raw dollars. The VP specifically asked about margin, not revenue, and a percentage is genuinely what actually answers that particular question honestly.

Reseller fulfillment specifically needs the ship-date relationship that Lesson 87 deliberately left inactive. USERELATIONSHIP activates that one specific relationship, but only for this single measure, without ever disturbing every other measure's normal use of OrderDateKey.

Trend over time, written using variables first and a single clean RETURN statement at the end — exactly the same readability pattern Chapter Five's variables lesson already taught you, rather than one giant wall of nested parentheses.

Every single measure genuinely traces straight back to one specific requirement — nothing extra, and nothing purely speculative sitting in the model. Lesson 89 finally builds the actual report pages these exact measures genuinely belong on.
